title: Add aggregate queue-depth metrics and runbook for Console ingress surge visibility
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Summary: During a capacity regression experiment on 2026-02-10 the Console ingress path experienced a surge that led to sustained queueing in the ingress worker pool. Existing telemetry only surfaced per-worker sampled latencies and a generic request_rate metric; we had no reliable aggregated queue depth, no percentile queue-depth heatmaps, and our tracing sampling missed many ingress->executor cold paths. Result: delayed user requests, misleading dashboards, and a delayed on-call escalation.

Root cause and impact: The surge correlated with a canary rollout that increased synchronous validation calls. The request bursts saturated the ingress executor queue, causing increased tail latency and backpressure to downstream services. Because we lacked a single aggregated queue-depth metric and had sparse trace sampling for the ingress path, the first detection was token-level tail spikes in console traces. This caused the on-call to chase symptoms rather than the queueing source for ~28 minutes. User-facing effects included slowed web console response and elevated retry rate.

Objective: Add durable visibility for aggregate queue depth and related signals, improve trace coverage for ingress cold-paths, create an incident runbook and alerts to detect and remediate similar surges earlier, and add mitigation toggles (circuit-breaker/fallback) for immediate self-healing during future experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregate queue depth metric (console.ingress.queue_depth_total) emitted from all ingress workers and reported as a single sum in Prometheus/Grafana
Per-tenant and global percentile queue-depth histogram dashboards added to Console observability Grafana with 99th/99.9th lines
Alert: console_ingress_queue_depth_sustained > X for 2m triggers P1 runbook with paging and suggested mitigation steps
Tracing sampling rate for ingress->executor path increased to 10% for full traces and 100% for error traces; trace points added at queue enqueue/dequeue and executor start
Runbook created and linked in Confluence with step-by-step throttling, canary rollback, and circuit-breaker instructions
Automated tests to validate queue metric emission under load in CI (load harness job)
tasks: Instrument and emit console.ingress.queue_depth gauges from ingress coordinator (Marcus)
Add a Prometheus recording rule to sum queue_depth across replicas and expose console.ingress.queue_depth_total (Telemetry)
Create Grafana dashboard panels: global aggregate, per-tenant heatmap, and 1m/5m/15m windows (Observability)
Increase tracing sampling and add enqueue/dequeue span events (Tracing)
Author Confluence runbook + escalation steps; attach to alert (Priya)
Add CI load test job validating metric emission and alert firing under synthetic surge (SRE)
Add a runtime toggle for ingress circuit-breaker with safe default (Engineering)
Ship a small canary to dedicated and run frequency test (QA)
Post-deployment: 48h observation window and dashboard smoke check (Marcus/Priya)
